shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi && echo '--- TICKET ---' && sed -n '1,260p' ../ticket.md && echo '--- DOD ---' && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
printf '%s\\n' '--- STATUS ---'
git status --short --branch
printf '%s\\n' '--- REGISTRY ---'
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
printf '%s\\n' '--- PACKAGE ---'
sed -n '1,180p' package.json
printf '%s\\n' '--- TEST COMMANDS ---'
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
printf '%s\\n' '--- TEST FILES ---'
rg --files src/orchestration | sort"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"interface ErrorObject|type ErrorObject|instancePath|interface Options\" node_modules/ajv node_modules/.pnpm 2>/dev/null | head -80
printf '%s\\n' '--- registry tests ---'
sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
printf '%s\\n' '--- acceptance ---'
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
printf '%s\\n' '--- specs ---'
sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\"
rg -n \"ajv\" package-lock.json | head
sed -n '75,100p' node_modules/ajv/lib/types/index.ts
sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/ajv/dist/types/index.d.ts
sed -n '1,180p' tsconfig.json
sed -n '1,180p' eslint.config.*"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"validated by|specs/.*#L|inputSchema|extra|Unknown tool\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -100
sed -n '160,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n \"instancePath|ErrorObject|Options\" src package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"spec anchor|specAnchor|spec:\" scripts .lore src --glob '*.mjs' --glob '*.ts' --glob '*.yml' | head -100
sed -n '1,220p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs
rg -n \"specs/.*#\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -30
rg -n \"spec:\" src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' | head -30"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs && echo yes || echo no
rg -n "reanchor" scripts .lore | head'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --check && git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix tool validation error paths" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
